value.rationale: Fixed-rate filtration allocation among emitting and nonemitting connected rooms is physically motivated. An exact positive activation threshold and divergent preferences of three legitimate exposure objectives guide interpretation of simple but widely used two-zone mass balance. The source-only benchmark is improved by a strictly interior rate split, with a nonzero asymptotic fractional benefit. Clinical/field generalization is not claimed.
